newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Glickman boosts North Plains beef co-op.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Glickman boosts North Plains beef co-op.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Friday the federal government would provide $75,000 to the North Dakota Department of Agriculture to help beef marketing.

The grant, to be provided through USDA's Federal-State Marketing Improvement Program, will be used to develop a business plan for a multi-state premium beef processing and marketing cooperative, Glickman said in a statement.
The cooperative, Northern Plains Premium Beef, comprises 2,833 producers from 15 states and two Canadian provinces, who have contributed seed money for the cooperative.
Separately, Glickman also said regulations implementing a 1996 farm bill loan guarantee program for cooperatives would be expedited and published in the next few weeks.
